Ideogram of a locus' chromosome with zoom trace

Source: R/geom-ideogram.R
plot_ideogram.Rd

Complete ideogram plot for the top of a track stack: the chromosome with the window highlighted, a zoom trace down to the tracks below, chromosome positions on top, and a title of the chromosome and cytoband span, e.g. "Chr 3 (q27.3)". Built from geom_ideogram() and its annotation layers, so it can be modified with +.

Usage

plot_ideogram(
  window_of_interest,
  flank = 0,
  data = NULL,
  highlight_fill = "#FFA319",
  zoom_trace = TRUE
)

Arguments

window_of_interest

Genomic window as a string, e.g. "chr3:187734001-187751500".

flank

Number of bp to extend both ends of the window, default: 0

data

GRanges object or data frame of cytobands with seqnames, start, end, name, and gieStain columns. Defaults to cytobands_hg38.

highlight_fill

Color of the window highlight and zoom trace.

zoom_trace

Draw the zoom trace, default: TRUE

Value

ggplot object

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
win <- "chr3:187734001-187751500"
patchwork::wrap_plots(plot_ideogram(win, flank = 5000),
                      bed_plot + coord_locus(win, flank = 5000),
                      ncol = 1, heights = c(0.4, 1))
} # }
